form.label: L2T - AppCompatCache (ShimCache) Forensics
form.description: Comprehensive analysis of Windows Application Compatibility Cache for tracking executed programs and application forensics

search.query: index=host sourcetype="l2t:AppCompatCache" | stats count by hostname | sort hostname
index=host sourcetype="l2t:AppCompatCache" | stats count by timestamp_desc | sort timestamp_desc
index=host sourcetype="l2t:AppCompatCache" | rex field=description "ControlSet(?<control_set>\d+)" | stats count by control_set | sort control_set

index=host sourcetype="l2t:AppCompatCache" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$executableSearch$*" OR description_short="*$executableSearch$*") | search (description="*$pathSearch$*" OR description_short="*$pathSearch$*") | search description="*$entrySearch$*" | rex field=description "ControlSet(?<control_set>\d+)" | search control_set=$controlSetFilter$ | dedup filename, source_long | stats count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:AppCompatCache" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$executableSearch$*" OR description_short="*$executableSearch$*") | search (description="*$pathSearch$*" OR description_short="*$pathSearch$*") | search description="*$entrySearch$*" | rex field=description "ControlSet(?<control_set>\d+)" | search control_set=$controlSetFilter$ | rex field=description "Path:\s*(?<executable_path>[^\\s]+.*?)(?:\s|$)" | rex field=executable_path "(?<executable_name>[^\\\\]+)$" | eval executable_name=ltrim(rtrim(executable_name)) | stats dc(executable_name)

index=host sourcetype="l2t:AppCompatCache" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$executableSearch$*" OR description_short="*$executableSearch$*") | search (description="*$pathSearch$*" OR description_short="*$pathSearch$*") | search description="*$entrySearch$*" | rex field=description "ControlSet(?<control_set>\d+)" | search control_set=$controlSetFilter$ | dedup filename, source_long | stats dc(filename)

index=host sourcetype="l2t:AppCompatCache" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$executableSearch$*" OR description_short="*$executableSearch$*") | search (description="*$pathSearch$*" OR description_short="*$pathSearch$*") | search description="*$entrySearch$*" | rex field=description "ControlSet(?<control_set>\d+)" | search control_set=$controlSetFilter$ | rex field=description "Path:\s*(?<executable_path>[^\\s]+.*?)(?:\s|$)" | eval risk_level=case( match(executable_path, "(?i)temp|tmp|downloads|desktop|recycle"), "High", match(executable_path, "(?i)users\\\\.*\\\\appdata|programdata"), "Medium", match(executable_path, "(?i)tsclient|removable"), "Medium", true(), "Low" ) | where risk_level!="Low" | dedup filename, source_long | stats count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:AppCompatCache" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$executableSearch$*" OR description_short="*$executableSearch$*") | search (description="*$pathSearch$*" OR description_short="*$pathSearch$*") | search description="*$entrySearch$*" | rex field=description "ControlSet(?<control_set>\d+)" | search control_set=$controlSetFilter$ | rex field=description "Path:\s*(?<executable_path>[^\\s]+.*?)(?:\s|$)" | rex field=executable_path "(?<executable_name>[^\\\\]+)$" | eval executable_name=ltrim(rtrim(executable_name)) | eval risk_level=case( match(executable_path, "(?i)temp|tmp|downloads|desktop"), "High", match(executable_path, "(?i)users\\\\.*\\\\appdata|programdata"), "Medium", match(executable_path, "(?i)tsclient|removable|recycle"), "Medium", match(executable_name, "(?i).*\\.(bat|cmd|vbs|ps1|scr)$"), "Medium", match(executable_name, "(?i).*(hack|crack|keygen|patch|loader).*"), "High", true(), "Low" ) | eval risk_indicators=case( match(executable_path, "(?i)temp|tmp"), "Temporary Directory", match(executable_path, "(?i)downloads"), "Downloads Folder", match(executable_path, "(?i)desktop"), "Desktop Location", match(executable_path, "(?i)tsclient"), "Remote Drive Access", match(executable_path, "(?i)recycle"), "Recycle Bin", match(executable_path, "(?i)appdata\\\\roaming"), "User Roaming Profile", match(executable_name, "(?i)\\.(bat|cmd|vbs|ps1)$"), "Script File", match(executable_name, "(?i).*(hack|crack|keygen).*"), "Suspicious Name Pattern", true(), "Standard Location" ) | where risk_level!="Low" | stats count as cache_count, values(hostname) as hosts, values(control_set) as control_sets, earliest(_time) as first_seen, latest(_time) as last_seen by executable_name, executable_path, risk_level, risk_indicators | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -risk | head 20

index=host sourcetype="l2t:AppCompatCache" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$executableSearch$*" OR description_short="*$executableSearch$*") | search (description="*$pathSearch$*" OR description_short="*$pathSearch$*") | search description="*$entrySearch$*" | rex field=description "ControlSet(?<control_set>\d+)" | search control_set=$controlSetFilter$ | eval control_set_name=case( control_set=="001", "ControlSet001 (Current)", control_set=="002", "ControlSet002 (LastKnownGood)", control_set=="003", "ControlSet003 (Backup)", isnotnull(control_set), "ControlSet"+control_set, true(), "Unknown" ) | dedup filename, source_long | stats count by control_set_name | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:AppCompatCache" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$executableSearch$*" OR description_short="*$executableSearch$*") | search (description="*$pathSearch$*" OR description_short="*$pathSearch$*") | search description="*$entrySearch$*" | rex field=description "ControlSet(?<control_set>\d+)" | search control_set=$controlSetFilter$ | rex field=description "Path:\s*(?<executable_path>[^\\s]+.*?)(?:\s|$)" | eval path_category=case( match(executable_path, "(?i)\\\\windows\\\\system32"), "System32", match(executable_path, "(?i)\\\\windows\\\\syswow64"), "SysWOW64", match(executable_path, "(?i)\\\\program files"), "Program Files", match(executable_path, "(?i)\\\\users\\\\"), "User Directories", match(executable_path, "(?i)\\\\temp\\\\|\\\\tmp\\\\"), "Temporary", match(executable_path, "(?i)tsclient"), "Remote/Network", match(executable_path, "(?i)recycle"), "Recycle Bin", match(executable_path, "(?i)\\\\windows\\\\"), "Windows Other", true(), "Other Locations" ) | dedup filename, source_long | stats count by path_category | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:AppCompatCache" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$executableSearch$*" OR description_short="*$executableSearch$*") | search (description="*$pathSearch$*" OR description_short="*$pathSearch$*") | search description="*$entrySearch$*" | rex field=description "ControlSet(?<control_set>\d+)" | search control_set=$controlSetFilter$ | rex field=description "Path:\s*(?<executable_path>[^\\s]+.*?)(?:\s|$)" | rex field=executable_path "(?<executable_name>[^\\\\]+)$" | eval executable_name=ltrim(rtrim(executable_name)) | eval full_path=executable_path | eval path_category=case( match(executable_path, "(?i)\\\\windows\\\\system32"), "System32", match(executable_path, "(?i)\\\\windows\\\\syswow64"), "SysWOW64", match(executable_path, "(?i)\\\\program files"), "Program Files", match(executable_path, "(?i)\\\\users\\\\"), "User Directories", match(executable_path, "(?i)\\\\temp\\\\|\\\\tmp\\\\"), "Temporary", match(executable_path, "(?i)tsclient"), "Remote/Network", match(executable_path, "(?i)recycle"), "Recycle Bin", true(), "Other Locations" ) | stats count as cache_entries, values(hostname) as hosts, values(control_set) as control_sets, values(path_category) as locations, dc(filename) as registry_sources by executable_name, full_path | sort -cache_entries | head 20

index=host sourcetype="l2t:AppCompatCache" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$executableSearch$*" OR description_short="*$executableSearch$*") | search (description="*$pathSearch$*" OR description_short="*$pathSearch$*") | search description="*$entrySearch$*" | rex field=description "ControlSet(?<control_set>\d+)" | search control_set=$controlSetFilter$ | eval registry_location=case( match(filename, "(?i)\\\\config\\\\system$"), "Active Registry", match(filename, "(?i)\\\\regback\\\\"), "Registry Backup", match(filename, "(?i)recycle"), "Deleted Registry", true(), "Other Registry Source" ) | stats count as cache_entries, dc(description) as unique_applications, values(hostname) as hosts by filename, registry_location | sort -cache_entries | head 15

index=host sourcetype="l2t:AppCompatCache" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$executableSearch$*" OR description_short="*$executableSearch$*") | search (description="*$pathSearch$*" OR description_short="*$pathSearch$*") | search description="*$entrySearch$*" | rex field=description "ControlSet(?<control_set>\d+)" | search control_set=$controlSetFilter$ | rex field=description "Path:\s*(?<executable_path>[^\\s]+.*?)(?:\s|$)" | rex field=description "Cached entry:\s*(?<entry_number>\d+)" | rex field=executable_path "(?<executable_name>[^\\\\]+)$" | eval executable_name=ltrim(rtrim(executable_name)) | eval risk_level=case( match(executable_path, "(?i)temp|tmp|downloads|desktop"), "High", match(executable_path, "(?i)users\\\\.*\\\\appdata|tsclient|recycle"), "Medium", true(), "Low" ) | eval registry_source=case( match(filename, "(?i)\\\\config\\\\system$"), "Active", match(filename, "(?i)\\\\regback\\\\"), "Backup", match(filename, "(?i)recycle"), "Deleted", true(), "Other" ) | eval short_path=if(len(executable_path)>60, "..."+substr(executable_path, len(executable_path)-57, 60), executable_path) | dedup filename, source_long | table datetime, hostname, executable_name, short_path, entry_number, control_set, registry_source, timestamp_desc, risk_level | sort -datetime
